string.text: I was getting tired of sitting here anyways.
I was one of the Tinkerers, I don't mind that word anymore, its no longer who I am, not any more. They abandoned me.
At first we just thought they wanted to rob us, they took and took but it was never enough for them. They got violent, my father tried talking but they just killed him first.
I stole a spear from one of them in the night, stabbed him while he slept, then I kept doing that, it felt right, like justice. The rest of them fled but I Have sworned to hunt them down
I am sorry to hear that. I could help you find them?
I don't care about your family, but if you want vengance on the world i can offer you that.
If you are offering the chance for me for vengance, I will happily offer you my spear.
I will bring justice to the world, one dead bandit at a time, will you help me?
